detected_project.project_type: Mixed operational analytics: binary-classifier monitoring, anomaly/drift detection, and governed agentic decision support
detected_project.primary_question: Can a new scored batch be trusted, has its distribution or labelled performance changed materially, and which bounded action should a human review?
detected_project.unit_of_analysis: One registered model plus one 1,000-row replay batch; model-level reference units are a credit-card account record or BRFSS respondent record.
detected_project.analysis_moment: After a feature batch arrives and is scored; outcomes may be complete, partial, or absent.
detected_project.claim_type: Diagnostic and operational, with predictive inputs; not causal.

profile.dataset: UCI Default of Credit Card Clients / Taiwan credit-card default
profile.split: group-aware stratified random held-out test split (test_size=0.20, random_state=42)
